response.text: The reversal pointers and the anomalies are still open, so I'll look at those next.

arguments.sql: SELECT h.*, (SELECT string_agg(l."LN_SEQ"||':'||l."ACCT_CD"||':'||l."DR_AMT"||'/'||l."CR_AMT", ' | ' ORDER BY l."LN_SEQ") FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE l."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO") lines FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE h."REF_JRNL_NO" IS NOT NULL OR h."JRNL_NO" IN (SELECT "REF_JRNL_NO" FROM "GLJRNH") OR h."MEMO" NOT IN ('Manual accrual') AND h."SRC_CD"='GL' OR h."POST_DT" NOT BETWEEN (SELECT "STRT_DT" FROM "GLPERD" p WHERE p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID") AND (SELECT "END_DT" FROM "GLPERD" p WHERE p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID")
SELECT p.*, i."INV_AMT", i."INV_NO", i."STAT_CD" FROM "APPAYM" p JOIN "APINVH" i USING ("INV_ID") WHERE p."PAY_AMT"<>i."INV_AMT"
SELECT "SRC_CD", split_part("MEMO",' ',1) m, count(*), min("JRNL_NO"), max("JRNL_NO"), count(DISTINCT "SRC_REF") FROM "GLJRNH" GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT l."ACCT_CD", a."ACCT_TYP", h."SRC_CD", count(*), sum(l."DR_AMT") dr, sum(l."CR_AMT") cr FROM "GLJRNL" l JOIN "GLJRNH" h USING ("JRNL_NO") LEFT JOIN "GLCOA" a USING ("ACCT_CD") GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,3
